{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Check for thousands separators
print("Revenue example before parsing:", data['revenue'].head().tolist())
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_order_mask = data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
print("Number of internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99):", test_order_mask.sum())

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
filtered_data = data[completed_mask & ~test_order_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_data['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
